' + '

Tronix.AI — Healthcare SaaS | AI Clinic Operations | Pilot Stage | 3 clinics live, 50+ in pipeline | Raising INR 3.5 Cr

' + '

Tronix.AI is an AI operating system for outpatient clinics. It does not record clinic work, it executes it: books the appointment, writes the SOAP note, generates the prescription and the bill, manages the queue and chases the follow-up. Everything runs over WhatsApp, so patients install nothing and staff retrain on nothing. Price is INR 15,000 per clinic per year. India has 1.2 million clinics handling 500 million OPD visits a month, the large majority still on phone calls and paper.

' + '

Market Opportunity
Across three live clinics: 60% reduction in administrative cost, 75% of front-desk processes automated, and 3–5 minutes saved per consultation. 50+ clinics in pipeline against a 1.2 million clinic base, with adoption pulled forward by the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission.

' + '

Founder-Market Fit
This is a distribution problem, not a model problem. Sachin Pundir (CEO) brings 20 years at PayTM, Videocon and AskmeBazaar and has built field-sales motions into Indian small business. Anuj Saxena (Product) spent 17 years at Expedia, Sinch and PayTM — Sinch being messaging infrastructure at scale, precisely what a WhatsApp-first product runs on. Anupam Singh (Technology) has 14 years leading large-scale telecom and financial systems. Dr. Anshuman Kumar, surgical oncologist at Max Healthcare for 25 years, provides clinical validation.

' + '

Key Investment Highlights
' + '• Sold against a salary line, not a software budget — INR 15,000 a year to automate three-quarters of front-desk work.
' + '• Zero adoption friction: no patient app and no staff retraining, the two reasons clinic software historically fails to stick in small practices.
' + '• CAC falls 5.5x, from INR 16,559 to INR 2,985 by FY29, as renewals and referrals displace paid acquisition; LTV/CAC moves from 4.5x to 14.4x.
' + '• Recurring mix compounds fast: renewals go from nothing to 45% of revenue by FY29 at an 80% renewal rate.
' + '• Fixed AI cost against variable revenue — gross margin inflects from negative in FY27 to 35% in FY29 and 67% in FY30.
' + '• Small cheque, defined trough: peak cumulative cash deficit is INR 2.28 Cr against a INR 3.5 Cr raise.

' + '

The Round
INR 3.5 Cr | 18-month runway | DCF enterprise value INR 15.42 Cr. Deployment: technology and AI 36%, customer acquisition 29%, team 20%, capex and overheads 15%. Year-one milestone: 3 to 323 paying clinics.

' + '

Recent Category Funding
Pype AI, building AI voice agents for hospitals and clinics, raised US$1.2M pre-seed led by Kalaari Capital. HealthPlix has raised US$44.5M and serves more than 10,000 doctors. Across the segment, 23 funded AI healthtech SaaS companies in India have raised US$667M between them, led by Innovaccer, Qure.ai and Doceree. Each sells a tool — documentation, voice or records — largely into hospitals. Tronix.AI is positioned differently by running the entire clinic workflow as one layer, priced for the 1.2 million small practices no enterprise vendor calls on.
